title: Environmental Services Supervisor (Nights)
ignored: Pay ($54,000–$62,000 plus night differential), benefits, the Sunday–Thursday night schedule, the hospital background, the equal-opportunity statement, and how to apply.

requirements.text: At least 3 years of environmental services or custodial experience, preferably in a healthcare setting
requirements.explanation: All three of your custodial jobs count, including your current hospital job.

requirements.text: Experience leading or supervising a team of custodial or housekeeping staff
requirements.explanation: You lead a crew of 6 custodians on the overnight shift.

requirements.text: Working knowledge of infection prevention and cleaning standards in a hospital
requirements.explanation: You clean patient rooms following infection prevention procedures and hold a CHEST certification.

requirements.text: Experience building staff schedules and covering call-offs
requirements.explanation: Your record says you lead a crew of 6, but not whether you build their schedules or cover call-offs.
requirements.question: Your record says you lead a crew of 6 custodians on the overnight shift. Do you also build their schedule or find coverage when someone calls off? If so, how often?

requirements.text: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
requirements.explanation: Your record lists Excel, but not Word or Outlook.
requirements.question: Your record lists Microsoft Excel. Do you also use Word or Outlook at work? If so, what do you use them for?

requirements.explanation: You have a high school diploma from Fairborn High School.

requirements.text: CHEST or another environmental services certification
Experience preparing for Joint Commission surveys
requirements.explanation: Your summary says you keep buildings inspection-ready, but nothing in your record mentions Joint Commission surveys.
requirements.question: Your summary says you keep buildings inspection-ready. Have you helped prepare for a Joint Commission or state health survey? If so, what was your part?

requirements.explanation: Your record says you speak English and Igbo, but not Spanish.
